launch_accessibility_smoke.mechanism: process launch + bounded MainWindowHandle wait + System.Windows.Automation subtree enumeration; fail-closed on early exit, missing automation window, empty Name or fewer than 10 controls

milestone_context: completes the second half of Issue #191's acceptance: the formal WinUI XAML build now succeeds and the shell launches with an observable automation tree on this target-class toolchain
first recorded formal XAML compile for the project; earlier evidence was limited to DesktopCompat/WinUICompat compatibility launches
limitations: Unsigned local preview only; no driver, WaveRT, HLK, Microsoft signing, installer or release-artifact evidence.
Accessibility smoke asserts presence of a populated named automation tree; it does not certify screen-reader conformance.
Smoke summary JSON stays under ignored .local/; nothing binary is committed.
